verdict.rationale: Meilisearch Cloud claims read high availability with 'native support for clusterization' (docs-14), and community users confirm a replicated/distributed version exists in paid tiers (comm-3). The documented self-hosting path, however, is a single binary (docs-11) plus Helm charts (docs-69). Scale evidence is single-node: about 80M documents on one 64GB box (comm-16) and 7M articles (comm-15), with RAM planning difficulties reported on large datasets (comm-5). Missing for 10: documented self-hosted replication/clustering or sharding guides, write high availability, an evidenced path to hundreds of millions of documents, and independent corroboration of the Cloud clustering claim.
